collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Watching children scramble up a palm, an elder wonders whether children everywhere climb trees.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Watching children scramble up a palm, (name1), an elder, wonders whether children everywhere climb trees.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The elder imagines distant children reaching for fruit and scraped knees, just like here.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A parent hopes distant parents worry just as much as they do.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A child wonders what children would climb instead; the answers become wilder and wilder.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A scholar suggests children might climb walls, rocks or anything else, because climbing seems to be what children do.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The elder climbs a short way up and is cheered by the children.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The elder decides the ground is perfectly comfortable and cheers from there.
